title: Boss हँसते हुए भी डरा सकता है
subtitle: Charm, confusion, blame aur survival ko Indian workplace mein pehchanne ka honest tareeka
credit: Yeh workplace manipulation aur organizational power ke principles se inspired independent Hinglish adaptation hai; Snakes in Suits ne central workplace question ko seed diya.
sources: Research traditions: workplace bullying, abusive supervision, organizational justice, psychological safety, burnout and power. Labels diagnosis nahi hain, aur saare characters aur scenes fictional hain. Har difficult manager clinical disorder wala nahi hota; institutional, legal and safety responses context par depend karte hain.
